description: A foundational isometric core exercise building full-body tension and spinal stability.
setup: Lie face down and prop yourself on your forearms with elbows directly under shoulders and feet together.
steps: Tuck your toes and lift your knees and torso until your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
Squeeze your glutes and pull your navel up toward your spine.
Press your forearms firmly into the floor to keep your upper back active and broad.
Breathe steadily while holding rigid tension without letting hips sag.
cues: Pull elbows toward toes isometrically to light up your abs
Keep a neutral neck looking down at your hands

mistakes.mistake: Sagging lower back and hips dipping toward the floor
mistakes.fix: Tuck pelvis into posterior tilt and squeeze glutes hard

mistakes.mistake: Piking hips high in the air to take load off the core
mistakes.fix: Lower hips until body is aligned in a flat horizontal line

rep_standard: Timer starts once body forms a rigid straight line on forearms, and stops immediately if hips sag or pike.
